title: SuperPipeline decision.released
description: A held approval reached its release time and acted, or was blocked (charter 2026-11-09, an approval may wait for its release time §5-7). Mirrors SuperPipeline's DecisionReleasedBody (apps/api/src/board/views.ts). Readers ignore properties they do not know.

boardId.description: Null only on a board not yet initialised; a carrier needs it to route the event.

decision.description: The gate's decision that was held, such as approve_automatic.

reason.description: Why a release was blocked; only on outcome blocked.
